name: ftc-programming-atlas
description: FTC Programming Atlas — Team-first FTC documentation for web, Android, and Windows

scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:build && npx cap sync
scripts.android:init: npm run mobile:build && npx cap add android && npm run android:assets
scripts.android:add: npm run mobile:build && npx cap add android
scripts.android:open: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run native:sync && node scripts/build-android.mjs release
scripts.ios:init: npm run mobile:build && npx cap add ios && npm run ios:assets
scripts.ios:add: npm run mobile:build && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run mobile:build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:doctor: node scripts/ios-preflight.mjs && npx cap doctor ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.desktop:exe: npm run mobile:build && node scripts/build-desktop.mjs nsis
scripts.desktop:portable: npm run mobile:build && node scripts/build-desktop.mjs portable
scripts.android:apk:debug: npm run native:sync && node scripts/build-android.mjs debug
scripts.native:release: npm run native:sync && npm run native:check
